title: Free Bet Blackjack
playGuide: Hit or stand, and take a free double or free split when one is offered
freeNotice: The house pays the raise on a free double or free split — you never lose it
dealer22Notice: The dealer busted with 22, so every remaining hand pushes
tutorial.bet: Place the ante. This is the only money of yours that goes on the table
tutorial.free: A hard 9-11 can be free-doubled; any pair but a ten-valued one can be free-split
tutorial.hands: Each stake is split into your money and the house's. Only the first is lost on a loss
frontendHint.freeBetFreeIsFree: the house pays the raise, so take it whenever it is offered
frontendHint.freeBetStandPat: 17 or more is a standing hand
frontendHint.freeBetDealerMayBust: the dealer's 22 only pushes, so busting yourself costs more here
